com.wac.autocore.ui.components

Class BookingMechanicsField

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.wac.autocore.ui.components.BookingMechanicsField

  • class BookingMechanicsField
extends java.lang.Object
    The mechanic field in the booking form: who is to do the job. The team follows the services, and whoever was taken out of the team is not put back.
